segments.name: Commercial
segments.description: Sells integrated video display systems, digital billboards and dynamic messaging systems to resellers, out-of-home companies, retailers, restaurants, casinos, shopping centers and petroleum retailers.
segments.evidence: Our Commercial business unit primarily consists of sales of our integrated video display systems, digital billboards, Galaxy ® and Fuelight ™ product lines, and dynamic messaging systems to resellers (primarily sign companies), out-of-home ("OOH") companies, national retailers, quick-serve restaurants, casinos, shopping centers, cruise ships, commercial building owners, and petroleum retailers.

segments.name: Live Events
segments.description: Provides integrated scoring and video display systems to professional sports venues, colleges and universities, and live event operators.
segments.evidence: The four domestic business units consist of Commercial, Live Events, High School Park and Recreation, and Transportation, all of which include the geographic territories of the United States and Canada.

segments.name: High School Park and Recreation
segments.description: Sells standard catalog products such as video boards and dynamic message systems to high school, park and recreation customers.
segments.evidence: We also use our direct sales force to sell to out-of-home advertising companies, transportation system operators, and certain high school, park and recreation customers.

segments.name: Transportation
products: ITS (intelligent transportation systems) dynamic message signs
segments.description: Supplies dynamic message signs, mass transit displays and intelligent transportation systems to transportation system operators and governmental agencies.
segments.evidence: The four domestic business units consist of Commercial, Live Events, High School Park and Recreation, and Transportation, all of which include the geographic territories of the United States and Canada.

segments.name: International
segments.description: Sells integrated display systems and standard catalog products to customers outside the United States and Canada through resellers and direct sales.
segments.evidence: Our five business segments consist of four domestic business units and the International business unit.

revenueModel.text: Customers, resellers and agencies pay for integrated display systems, installation, software, and ongoing technical support and service agreements.
revenueModel.evidence: In addition to equipment sales and installation, the Company provides services that include technical support, professional services, and software-based solutions that enable customers to operate and manage their display systems.
